typeInference.rule: Check the mapped component name first, then the slot's semantic role, against a media keyword set and a content keyword set. media wins on a media-keyword hit (Image/Logo/photo/icon/...); otherwise content on a content-keyword hit (Heading/Eyebrow/Rich Text/Link/Form/...). Unmatched slots default to 'content' and are flagged ambiguous.
